pr_title: Destroy Sway subsurfaces when destroying Sway layer_surface

issue_context.title: Use after free in client→surface→subsurface destroy
issue_context.body:
Void Linux (amd64/musl), sway 1.6, wlroots 0.13.0.

Happens sometimes when closing swaylock, crashing sway with SEGV (under valgrind it reports the error but continues normally; under gdb it crashed at `struct sway_output *output = wlr_output->data;` as `wlr_output` was garbage [not even null]). Valgrind trace:

By the time `subsurface_handle_unmap` is called, the corresponding layer_surface is destroyed already so `subsurface->layer_surface` is dangling. That seems to be because both destroying the layer_surface and unmapping the subsurfaces are called via the surface’s `destroy` signal but in a wrong order (in no predefined order, I suppose).
comments: When destroying the layer surface, we should cleanup all surface children in Sway.
If you can still reproduce please re-open.

review_comments: Instead of setting up an event listener, can we just iterate over the layer sub-surfaces and destroy them in `handle_destroy`?
Probably. I did it this way only because everything else here seems to work this way. What you suggest is probably better.

The rest of the event listeners are listening to wlroots events. wlroots doesn't know about Sway, so we need this complexity in the wlroots API.

However for Sway-internal stuff we shouldn't need it.
